newsitem.title: UK: B.A.T shares up further in pre-market.
newsitem.headline: B.A.T shares up further in pre-market.

text.p: B.A.T Industries Plc shares were marked higher in pre-market trade on Thursday in further reaction to confirmation late yesterday of U.S. talks on a possible settlement of litigation against the industry.
With Philip Morris Cos closing $4-3/4 higher at $43-1/4 in New York, B.A.T shares were up 7-1/2p at 548-1/2 by 0702 GMT.
Several state attorneys said tobacco industry executives were negotiating for the first time on a possible settlement, though one said an agreement was "not imminent."
The influential Financial Times Lex column said the "potential rewards to investors (in tobacco stocks) probably still outweigh the risks, given the extent of their discount ratings."

"We're going to see something pretty impressive with B.A.T again today," said one dealer. B.A.T shares closed 28p higher yesterday on confirmation of the talks, and as Morris reported strong first-quarter earnings.
No-one at B.A.T was immediately available for comment.
